subject: PO requirements, invoice cadence and net terms for Twill pilot
messages:

Cc: procurement@twill.io <procurement@twill.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Twill pilot — PO format and invoice cadence

Hi Marissa,

We're getting the internal procurement checklist aligned for the Twill pilot and had a couple quick questions about how Redwood needs POs and invoices structured so our S2P system will accept them. Our AP team flagged three items:

1) Required PO header fields: PO number, remit entity name, remit address, vendor tax id, and an explicit line for "service period" per invoice. Is Redwood able to populate explicit line-level descriptions on invoices (we need line-level PO matching).

2) Net terms: our default is Net60 but we can flex to Net45 if needed — would Redwood consider Net60 for this pilot? If not, do you support monthly consolidated statements (one invoice referencing multiple PO lines) rather than weekly micro-invoices?

3) Partial invoices: Can Redwood issue partial invoices against a single PO (we sometimes receive multiple invoices referencing the same PO number and the system requires unique line identifiers for each invoice).

I've attached our PO template so you can see the fields (Twill_PO_Template_v2.pdf).

If you can confirm what's feasible on your side (and any required vendor information you need), procurement will draft the PO. We're on a tight timeline — would like to get billing/PO alignment this week if possible.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, Twill
liam.oconnor@twill.io
procurement@twill.io

Subject: Re: Twill pilot — PO format and invoice cadence

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the template and the clear list. Quick answers below, with proposed next steps.

1) PO header / line-level matching: Yes — we can include a vendor tax ID and remit entity on every invoice. We also support line-level descriptions tied to PO line numbers. Our invoices can include a "service period" and map charge lines to the PO_line_id field your system needs. We'll need your PO line numbering convention (e.g., PO-12345-L1) so we can populate the invoice reference consistently.

2) Net terms / cadence: Our standard is Net45. For enterprise pilots we can make an exception to Net60 provided we have either (a) an approved credit check on file or (b) a consolidated monthly statement workflow with POs referencing line items. If you can accept monthly consolidated statements, we can agree Net60 for this pilot.

3) Partial invoices: We can issue partial invoices against a single PO, but your AP requirement for unique line identifiers must be satisfied. We recommend using an invoice_reference that includes the PO number + invoice sequence (PO-12345 | INV-001) so it passes your match rules.

Attachments: I've included a short guide that outlines the PO fields we can populate and our recommended mapping (Redwood_PO_Guide_v1.pdf).

Next steps: If you confirm the PO line id format and that monthly consolidated statements are acceptable, we'll route to finance and can supply our vendor tax id + remit details and a draft order form for signature.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk AP through the invoice mapping — let me know availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing Redwood_PO_Guide_v1.pdf and running the template through our system:

• PO line identifiers: Twill requires each invoice line to include a PO_line_id that matches the PO file. We cannot accept an invoice that references a PO number without a matching PO_line_id. That means partial invoices are fine, but every line on an invoice must carry the PO_line_id exactly as on the PO.

• Monthly consolidated statements: Acceptable — procurement will accept a single consolidated invoice issued monthly that references multiple PO lines, as long as each line preserves PO_line_id and service period.

• Net60 concession: Procurement confirms we can accept Net60 for the pilot provided Redwood signs the MOU and provides remit bank details + vendor tax id prior to the first invoice. We will not be able to push payment earlier than Net60 without an early-pay agreement.

• Additional ask: for our ERP to auto-match, kindly include vendor_tax_id and remit_address in the invoice header and put a machine-readable invoice_reference (PO12345_INV001) in the invoice metadata.

Attaching our system spec sheet showing the exact XML/CSV fields (Twill_PO_System_Specs.xlsx). Once we receive Redwood's vendor info and a short MOU that captures Net60 + monthly consolidated cadence, procurement will issue the PO.

Regards,
